items.headline: The Morning Build for November 9, 2026: Nvidia's Board Probe, Goldman Locks Claude Code, and IPO, Auditor Limits
items.excerpt: Nvidia's board launched an independent probe after Jensen Huang's apology; Goldman restricts Claude Code; auditor study shows high false alarms; Anthropic aims to IPO before Thanksgiving.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 8, 2026: Meta's Muse Spaces, tiny 32MB speech model, and why coding agents still need humans
items.excerpt: Meta ships Spaces for Muse agents; Underdog demos a 32MB speech model; Claude Code leaks secrets; Microsoft ends AI Frontiers; Co-Design Bench shows agents finish only 26.4% of tasks.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 7, 2026: OpenAI's $11B Round, Airbnb's 2027 Agent, and Google’s Video and Health AI
items.excerpt: OpenAI raises $11B at a $1.25T valuation; Airbnb vows an AI travel agent H1 2027; Ripple: 65B hits Hugging Face under Apache 2.0; Google publishes cuffless BP study and ships Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 6, 2026: GPT-6 Cyber, Palo Alto Talks for Clutch, and Baidu’s ERNIE 5.5 Flash
items.excerpt: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Cyber finds and exploits real bugs; Palo Alto in talks to buy Clutch for $500M; Baidu open-sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash base (280B params).

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 5, 2026: GPT-6 Astra Weight Editing, OpenAI Images 2.6 GIFs, Meta Buys Conductor
items.excerpt: GPT-6 Astra edits model weights; OpenAI adds GIFs with Images 2.6; Meta buys Conductor and ends its cloud on Nov 20; CloudOpsBench flags reasoning failures; Lehane probes 2028 AI policy.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 4, 2026: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra Hardware, Anthropic's FlashProve, and Fal's $1.3B Raise
items.excerpt: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed hardware in under a week; Anthropic releases FlashProve spec and code; Fal raises $1.3B; Stanford shows rapid LLM claim decay; economists pitch mechanism design.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 3, 2026: OpenAI Unifies Chat and Work, Squarespace Cuts 19%, and Weight-Space Editing by Astra
items.excerpt: OpenAI merges Chat and Work tabs; Squarespace cuts ~300 roles; Astra edits weights; OpenAI raises bounties to $172k; Anthropic blocks game-cloning in Claude Code.
